cases.input: How many customers are from Canada?
cases.expected_behavior: 直接执行：客户居住国等于 Canada 的客户计数。
business_basis: schema: customer.country 为客户所在地
live_database_facts.countries 中 Canada 为真实客户国家值
confirmed_business_rules.general.region: customer.country 是客户所在地，保留各自含义
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM public.customer WHERE country = 'Canada';
cases.canonical_input: How many customers are from Canada?

cases.input: What was the total invoice revenue for France in 2022?
cases.expected_behavior: 直接执行：账单国为 France、发票日期在2022年左闭右开区间内的发票销售额求和。

allowed_interpretations.filter: customer.country = 'France' 且 2022 年（仅当明确客户居住国口径）

business_basis: schema: invoice.billing_country 为账单地址国；customer.country 为客户所在地
live_database_facts.billing_countries 中 France 为真实账单国值
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE billing_country = 'France' AND invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01';
cases.canonical_input: What was the total invoice revenue for France in 2022?

cases.input: Iron Maiden乐队一共有多少张专辑？
cases.expected_behavior: 仅改写：approved 别名“Iron Maiden乐队”唯一绑定 artist.name = 'Iron Maiden'，统计该艺术家的专辑数。
business_basis: approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations: alias_id a-7a0187a2e65d10ae, standard_value 'Iron Maiden', column artist.name, review_status approved
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM public.album al JOIN public.artist ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'Iron Maiden';
cases.canonical_input: Iron Maiden乐队一共有多少张专辑？

cases.input: 法兰西共和国的发票一共开了多少张？
cases.expected_behavior: 仅改写：approved 别名“法兰西共和国”唯一绑定 customer.country = 'France' 或 invoice.billing_country = 'France'；按客户所在地口径统计 France 客户的发票张数。
business_basis: approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations: alias_id a-ca229f69098da675, standard_value 'France', column customer.country, review_status approved
approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations: alias_id a-99f7789e108299a0, standard_value 'France', column invoice.billing_country, review_status approved
confirmed_business_rules.general.region: 两个国家字段保留各自含义
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'France';
cases.canonical_input: 法兰西共和国的发票一共开了多少张？

cases.input: 受保护AAC音频文件这种媒体格式有多少首曲目？
cases.expected_behavior: 仅改写：approved 别名“受保护AAC音频文件”唯一绑定 media_type.name = 'Protected AAC audio file'，统计该格式曲目数。
business_basis: approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations: alias_id a-bfc4b2a75ae6d393, standard_value 'Protected AAC audio file', column media_type.name, review_status approved
live_database_facts.media_types 中 Protected AAC audio file 为真实值
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM public.track t JOIN public.media_type mt ON t.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id WHERE mt.name = 'Protected AAC audio file';
cases.canonical_input: 受保护AAC音频文件这种媒体格式有多少首曲目？
